title: Half-BPS Impurity Backgrounds and Supersymmetry
summary: We develop a rigid $\mathscr{N} =(1,1)$ superspace framework for spatially inhomogeneous impurity deformations in $D=1+1$ dimensions by embedding the impurity profile into a real background superfield (spurion). This spurionic completion provides a manifestly supersymmetric description at the level of the action and offers a systematic route to identify which inhomogeneous backgrounds preserve a nontrivial subset of supercharges.
